desc: Build exact component-triple game model (a,b,f per component) with fill/merge moves, cross-validated against edge-bitmask DP for all bipartite graphs N≤4; confirm odd-N rule (W = M mod 2) and even-N o=0 rule (W = (M+F+i/2) mod 2) via anchors and exhaustive tabulation.

Run the analyzer program; from the exhaustive N≤6 tables and the N≤10 family grid, extract the exact winning rule for the even-N, o≥1 case — determine whether W depends only on (o,i,e,fills) or needs extra features (side sizes, Σa·b), and whether fills matter exactly or only by parity; write down the fitted closed-form rule.

Prove the full rule: terminal states are K_{a,b} with T=ab−M; odd N ⇒ winner = M parity; even N,o=0 ⇒ (M+F+i/2) parity; even N,o≥1 ⇒ the player making the last free-choice odd-odd merge sets final color-class parity and wins — justify the fitted seize-game criterion on (o,i,e,fills).
Implement final O((N+M)·α(N)) solution: parity DSU/BFS to get each component's side sizes, derive N,M,o,i,e,F,fills, apply the proven three-case rule, print Aoki/Takahashi.

Stress-test the final closed form against the brute force on all N≤6 positions, the N≤10 family grid, and edge cases (empty graph, already-terminal K_{a,b}, single edge, all isolates, mixed isolate/non-isolate odd components) before submitting.
